answer: Refused: a core/server, our own status protocol (a label instead), a TUI, splits/tabs/layout, a config tree, an MCP server for now, a screen renderer of our own. Deferred, not refused: remote sessions, agent coordination beyond labels, manifest. Two tests for anything proposed — does it plug into an affordance zmx already has, and is it the least code that makes agent work faster.
body: Candidate refusals: a core/server of our own; a status protocol (use a label); a declarative session manifest; layout, theme and keymap files; remote machines over SSH; a screen renderer of our own; plugin/mod surface.
title: What do we refuse?
